related_library: 原包（桌面双文件夹布局中的同级资料库）

precedence.runtime_truth: current DLL and verification output first; then the user's Player.log, logs/error_*.log, and selected mod source/build output at user-provided paths
precedence.archive: legacy and full installed-mod source snapshot removed

notes: Raw game API and Publicized compile API are intentionally separate.
The curated source snapshot was removed; when a concrete mod is involved, read only the user's selected mod source and project files at their actual paths.
Player-specific runtime logs are intentionally excluded; when diagnosing behavior, read the current user's Player.log and error logs at their actual paths.
WorldBox, Mods, log, and source paths vary by user; never assume D:\worldbox or the generation machine's absolute paths.
Do not trust path_at_generation as a runtime path; use portable_path and verify hashes.
The human HTML report is present in this package for manual browsing, but it is not a default AI source.
The legacy archive and full installed-mod source snapshot were removed as obsolete.
